row.geographic_scope: MA meridional monitoring section north of Madeira, source-defined regional Azores Current window; exact coordinates not independently qualified
row.qualification: Source Section2 reports Azores upper-layer transport to600m at MA, with deeper transport strongly affected by bathymetry; Figure2 is IBI-REA1993–2021mean. This is neither a new direct observation nor a reconstructed velocity threshold crossing. Section2 labels the current eastward, while monitoring-window setup and signed transport discussion call AC westward; keep direction unresolved and do not transfer an axis or sign. The OMIs use dynamic density-based vertical windows;600m is prose describing the mean section, not a fixed OMI boundary or physical current bottom.

caveats: Mean-section lower reach, not mean individual current depths, annual extrema, calendar climatology, uncertainty or everywhere thickness.
Four reanalyses plus one reprocessed-observation product support the ensemble OMI; Figure2 mean is specifically IBI-REA. Do not relabel600m as a five-product measured mean depth.
Direction labels conflict within the paper; exact position, flow sign and direction are unresolved. Retain Azores attribution without geographic edge, route or state projection.
The primary seamount wording also changes geographic reference. No coordinates inferred from that wording or digitized from a plot.
Transport anomalies remove the monthly climatology; the OMI anomaly record does not supply monthly depth evolution.
No raw model arrays obtained; no core, bed, dynamic density boundary, selected transport layer or volume substituted for current thickness.
